svg.font-family: Inter, 'Noto Sans KR', 'Apple SD Gothic Neo', 'Malgun Gothic', 'Segoe UI', Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: FitMate System Architecture
svg.desc: FitMate mobile app calls a Spring Boot container on Amazon EC2 (Docker Compose with MySQL container); Spring Boot calls the OpenAI API. GitHub Actions builds an image, pushes it to Amazon ECR and sends a deploy command to EC2 through AWS Systems Manager; EC2 pulls the image from ECR.
